value.text: {"result": {"suggestions": [{"kind": "existing_thesis", "pillar_id": "GOOGL.p2", "stance": "supports", "strength": 3, "wrong_if_met": false, "assumptions": [], "rationale": "Alphabet itself reports a shorter useful life that raises depreciation and says Cloud operating margin will be hit harder, which bears directly on the pillar's depreciation and margin compression; the wrong-if test (Cloud growth and margin offsetting the step-up) is not reported as met.", "claim_ids": ["synthetic_000366.c1", "synthetic_000366.c2", "synthetic_000366.c3", "synthetic_000366.c5"], "sections": [{"email_id": "synthetic_000366", "quote": "we are reducing the estimated useful life of certain AI-accelerated servers and associated networking equipment from six years to five years, effective October 1, 2026, on a prospective basis."}, {"email_id": "synthetic_000366", "quote": "Depreciation expense in Q4 2026 is expected to increase by approximately $0.7 billion relative to the prior estimate."}, {"email_id": "synthetic_000366", "quote": "For full-year 2027, we currently estimate an increase in depreciation expense of approximately $3.9 billion, depending on the pace of capital deployment."}, {"email_id": "synthetic_000366", "quote": "We expect Google Cloud operating margin to be affected more than Services."}]}], "no_change_reason": null}}
